description: Parse raw request-header text, one "Header-Name: value" per line, into decoded client hint values: brand/version pairs for Sec-CH-UA-style headers, booleans for ?1/?0 values, unquoted strings, and numbers. Lines whose header name isn't a recognized client hint are returned separately under "unrecognized" rather than dropped.

headers.description: Raw request-header text to parse, one "Header-Name: value" per line

name: parse_client_hint_headers
